description: Jeju Yuja Balancing Pad is a pre-soaked toner pad from Korean brand VVBetter, built around vitamin-C-rich Jeju yuja (citron) extract with PHA and Zinc PCA. It combines gentle chemical exfoliation with sebum control and soothing hydration in a single wipe-and-leave-on step. It is positioned for oily, blemish-prone and sensitive skin as part of a maintenance regimen.
howItWorks: Gluconolactone (PHA) loosens the bonds between surface corneocytes to gently exfoliate and refine texture without the sting of stronger acids, while yuja extract supplies antioxidant vitamin C to support a brighter, more even tone. Zinc PCA helps regulate sebum and, together with soothing botanicals, calms reactive skin and supports barrier comfort.
composition: Jeju yuja (Citrus junos) fruit extract, gluconolactone (PHA), Zinc PCA and a soothing/hydrating botanical blend on an embossed micro-hole pad. Vegan-certified formulation.
usageNotes: Clinic-dispensed for home use. After cleansing, wipe the textured side across face and neck to sweep away dead cells, or lay pads on as a 3-5 minute localised compress for hydration and soothing. Introduce acid-based pads gradually in sensitive patients and reinforce daily broad-spectrum SPF given the increased exfoliation.
features: Dual-textured micro-hole pad for exfoliating or compress use
Vegan-certified, suited to sensitive and blemish-prone skin
benefits: Dispensary line item that supports at-home maintenance between in-clinic treatments
Gentle acid profile widens patient suitability, including reactive skin
Multi-benefit action (exfoliate, mattify, soothe) simplifies homecare advice
Complements peel and retinoid protocols as a low-strength upkeep step
Recognisable K-beauty positioning aids patient uptake
indications: Ongoing maintenance between clinical exfoliation sessions

description: Jeju Yuja Balancing Bubble Cleanser is a low-pH foaming cleanser from VVBetter featuring Jeju yuja extract with AHA (citric acid) and BHA (salicylic acid). It lifts sebum and impurities while probiotic ferment and ceramide help preserve the moisture barrier. It is formulated for daily use on oily and blemish-prone skin.
howItWorks: Mild amphoteric and glucoside surfactants emulsify sebum and debris, while low levels of citric acid (AHA) exfoliate the surface and salicylic acid (BHA) penetrates sebum to help clear pores. Lactobacillus ferment, ceramide NP, beta-glucan and Centella help offset the drying tendency of cleansing to support a comfortable, balanced barrier.
composition: Jeju yuja (Citrus junos) extract, citric acid (~0.62% AHA), salicylic acid (~0.5% BHA), Zinc PCA, niacinamide, ceramide NP, Lactobacillus ferment lysate, Centella asiatica and beta-glucan in a mild surfactant base.
usageNotes: Clinic-dispensed for home use. Massage a pump of foam over damp skin then rinse thoroughly; suitable morning and evening. In patients concurrently using peels or retinoids, monitor for over-exfoliation and reinforce daily broad-spectrum SPF.
features: AHA (citric) + BHA (salicylic) for surface and pore-level exfoliation
Zinc PCA and niacinamide for oil balance and tone
Ceramide NP, beta-glucan and Lactobacillus ferment for barrier support
benefits: First-step homecare that primes skin for in-clinic protocols
Barrier-supporting actives broaden tolerability for daily use
Pairs with the wider Jeju Yuja balancing range for bundling
Targets oil and congestion without harsh stripping
Familiar K-beauty cleanser format encourages compliance

description: Jeju Yuja Cera Balancing Cream is a lightweight barrier-repair moisturiser from VVBetter that pairs vitamin-C-rich Jeju yuja extract with encapsulated ceramides. The gel-cream texture targets hydration and barrier reinforcement while soothing botanicals calm sensitive, blemish-prone skin. It completes the balancing routine after cleansing and toning.
howItWorks: Encapsulated ceramide microcapsules dissolve on application to replenish intercellular lipids and strengthen the stratum corneum, while panthenol, squalane and hyaluronic acid bind and hold water for sustained hydration. Zinc and soothing extracts (Centella, Houttuynia, holy basil) help balance oil and reduce the appearance of irritation.
composition: Encapsulated ceramides, Jeju yuja (Citrus junos) extract, panthenol, squalane, hyaluronic acid, Zinc, Centella asiatica, Houttuynia cordata and holy basil; patented MOISTURE B blend (0.5%). Vegan-certified.
usageNotes: Clinic-dispensed for home use. Apply as the final leave-on moisturising step morning and evening. Well suited as the barrier-support step alongside exfoliating or retinoid regimens; continue daily broad-spectrum SPF.
features: Panthenol, squalane and hyaluronic acid for hydration
Zinc and soothing botanicals for balance and comfort
benefits: Barrier-support step that helps patients tolerate active protocols
Lightweight finish suits oily and combination skin underserved by rich creams
Rounds out the Jeju Yuja range for a complete dispensary bundle
Soothing profile suits sensitive and post-procedure skin
Recognisable K-beauty branding supports retail uptake
indications: Oily and combination skin needing lightweight hydration
Maintenance alongside exfoliating or retinoid regimens

description: Derma Factory Retinal 300ppm Cream is a Korean night treatment built on liposome-encapsulated retinaldehyde (retinal) at 300ppm (0.03%), supported by niacinamide, panthenol and a high proportion of Centella asiatica leaf water. Retinaldehyde sits one conversion step from active retinoic acid, offering retinoid efficacy with a comparatively gentle profile. It targets fine lines, texture and tone as a firming, elasticity-focused cream.
howItWorks: Retinaldehyde is a retinoid that the skin converts in a single step to retinoic acid, which binds nuclear retinoid receptors to normalise keratinocyte turnover and stimulate collagen synthesis, smoothing fine lines and refining texture over time. Liposomal encapsulation moderates delivery for tolerability, while niacinamide supports tone and barrier and Centella and panthenol soothe.
composition: Retinal (retinaldehyde) 300ppm (0.03%) in liposomes, Centella asiatica leaf water (~66%), niacinamide (~2%), panthenol (~2%) and adenosine (~0.04%).
usageNotes: Clinic-dispensed for home use, PM only. Introduce retinoids gradually (e.g. every 2-3 nights, building to nightly as tolerated) to limit retinisation dryness and irritation; apply to dry skin and buffer with moisturiser in sensitive patients. Mandatory daily broad-spectrum SPF; avoid in pregnancy and breastfeeding.
features: Liposome encapsulation for moderated, tolerable delivery
Niacinamide for tone and barrier support
High Centella asiatica leaf water base for soothing
Adenosine and panthenol for anti-wrinkle and comfort support
benefits: Adds a credible retinoid tier to the dispensary between retinol and prescription tretinoin
Gentler retinaldehyde profile broadens patient candidacy
Anchors anti-ageing and texture protocols as homecare
Encapsulation and soothing base aid adherence
Complements in-clinic resurfacing with maintenance turnover support

description: GD11 Premium RX Treatment Mask is a Korean anti-ageing sheet mask delivering umbilical-cord-blood stem-cell conditioned media (pro-liposome, 5,000ppm) on a close-adhering Tencel sheet. The conditioned media supplies growth factors and cytokines alongside a peptide complex, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid and soothing botanicals. It is positioned as an intensive recovery and elasticity mask, well suited to post-procedure conditioning.
howItWorks: Stem-cell conditioned media provides a cocktail of secreted growth factors and cytokines (the paracrine signals cells release) that support fibroblast activity and skin recovery, complemented by peptides that cue regeneration. Hyaluronic acid, panthenol and Centella deliver occlusive hydration and soothing under the Tencel sheet to strengthen the barrier and improve elasticity and radiance.
composition: Pro-liposome umbilical cord blood stem cell conditioned media (5,000ppm), peptide complex, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, panthenol, allantoin, Centella asiatica, Camellia sinensis, Aloe barbadensis and licorice root extract; Tencel sheet. Paraben- and colorant-free.
usageNotes: Professional or clinic-dispensed. Apply to cleansed skin for 15-20 minutes, then pat in the residual essence; where supplied with freeze-dried powder, mix immediately before use. A useful soothing, hydrating step after non-ablative procedures per practitioner judgement.
features: Umbilical cord blood stem-cell conditioned media at 5,000ppm
Niacinamide and hyaluronic acid for tone and hydration
benefits: Premium, high-margin sheet mask for retail and post-treatment use
Soothing and hydrating profile suits post-procedure recovery protocols
Regeneration positioning aligns with anti-ageing service menus
Single-use hygiene and convenience aid patient compliance
Distinct conditioned-media story supports premium pricing
indications: Loss of elasticity and early ageing

description: LHALA Peel (LHA La Peel) is a professional Korean chemical peel from H2Medi built around lipohydroxy acid (LHA), a lipophilic salicylic-acid derivative, combined with skin-identical lipids and the brand's P-Sol complex. Marketed as a low-downtime 'glass skin' peel, it aims to exfoliate evenly while supporting the barrier. It is intended for in-clinic professional application.
howItWorks: LHA (capryloyl salicylic acid) is lipophilic and acts largely at the follicular level, detaching corneocytes slowly and evenly for controlled exfoliation with less irritation than fast-acting acids. Accompanying phospholipids act as a temporary barrier substitute during recovery, while the P-Sol complex (olive- and coconut-derived) is positioned to support fibroblast activity and barrier strength.
composition: Lipohydroxy acid (LHA / capryloyl salicylic acid), skin-identical lipids (phospholipids) and P-Sol complex (derived from olive and coconut oils).
usageNotes: Professional use only, applied by a trained practitioner. Follow the manufacturer's protocol for layering, contact time and neutralisation/removal; assess skin type first and space sessions (commonly around weekly per brand guidance). Reinforce strict post-peel photoprotection and barrier care, and avoid concurrent home exfoliants around treatment.
features: Lipophilic LHA for slow, even exfoliation
benefits: Adds a gentle, low-downtime peel tier to the treatment menu
LHA tolerability suits patients unsuited to aggressive peels
Barrier-support angle differentiates from conventional acid peels
Repeatable protocol supports course-based bookings
Pairs with matching homecare cleanser for full-journey selling

description: LHALA Foam (LHA La Foam) is a hypoallergenic micro-foam cleanser from H2Medi designed to accompany the LHALA peel system. It uses an amino-acid and APG surfactant complex with plant extracts and is engineered to cleanse while preserving the skin's natural lipids. It suits sensitive and post-peel skin as a gentle daily cleanser.
howItWorks: A mild amino-acid plus alkyl-polyglucoside (APG) surfactant complex lifts impurities and excess sebum while, per the brand, retaining the majority of the skin's natural lipids to avoid over-stripping. The fine micro-foam and near-physiological pH are positioned to cleanse thoroughly while supporting barrier comfort; it can also be left on briefly as a foam mask.
composition: Amino-acid + APG mild surfactant complex with a plant-extract blend including chamomile, licorice and green tea (brand-stated multi-extract and amino-acid formula). Full quantitative actives not verified.
usageNotes: Clinic-dispensed for home use. Work the micro-foam over damp skin and rinse; may be left on briefly as a foam mask per brand guidance. Well suited to sensitive and post-peel skin as a gentle daily cleanser within the LHALA regimen.
features: Companion to the LHALA peel system
benefits: Natural homecare pairing that extends peel results
Gentle profile suits sensitive and post-procedure patients
Supports bundled selling with the LHALA peel
Daily-use format encourages routine compliance
Barrier-friendly cleansing reduces irritation risk during active protocols
indications: Daily maintenance within an exfoliation regimen

description: The Elaxen Skin Care Set is a professional Korean skin-rejuvenation ampoule system supplied as sterile vials of Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) solution for practitioner-administered mesotherapy and microneedling. PLLA is a biostimulatory material used to prompt gradual collagen production for firmness and texture rather than immediate volumisation. It is strictly for use by licensed medical and aesthetic professionals.
howItWorks: Poly-L-lactic acid acts as a biostimulator: micro-delivered into the skin it prompts a controlled fibroblast response and neocollagenesis over subsequent weeks, gradually improving firmness, thickness and texture. As a stimulatory agent its effect builds over a course rather than producing an instant fill.
composition: Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) solution, supplied as sterile ampoules/vials (reported as 5 vials x 10 mL). Full excipient list not verified.
usageNotes: Professional use only, administered by a licensed practitioner via mesotherapy, microneedling/MTS or similar; not for self-administration. Prepare and inject strictly per the manufacturer's instructions; results build over a multi-session course. Confirm exact set contents and volumes with the supplier at order.
features: Sterile sealed vials for professional use
Collagen stimulation rather than immediate volumising
Suitable for face, neck, hands and decolletage
benefits: Adds a collagen-biostimulation option to the professional menu
Course-based protocol supports recurring appointments
Complements needle/MTS and energy-device workflows
Gradual, natural-looking improvement narrative for patients
Multi-zone use broadens treatment applicability
indications: Fine lines and early skin ageing

description: Black Peel is a professional exfoliating peel centred on fermented black rice vinegar (black acetic acid) with niacinamide, described by its maker (Theraderm) as a patented cosmetic composition for acne-prone and troubled skin. It is positioned as a plant-acid-based peel to unclog pores, clear dead cells and improve clarity. It is intended for in-clinic professional application.
howItWorks: The acetic acid from fermented black rice vinegar acts as the exfoliating acid, loosening and dissolving dead corneocytes and helping to decongest pores, while niacinamide supports oil regulation, tone and post-inflammatory recovery. The plant-acid basis is positioned as a comparatively gentle route to clarity for oily, blemish-prone and melanin-rich skin.
composition: Fermented black rice vinegar (black acetic acid) and niacinamide (manufacturer-stated actives). Additional actives sometimes cited for 'black peel' formulas are not verified for this specific product.
usageNotes: Professional use only, applied by a trained practitioner following the manufacturer's protocol for layering, contact time and neutralisation/removal. Patch-test and assess skin type first; peels can carry post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation risk in darker phototypes, so titrate strength and reinforce strict post-peel photoprotection and barrier care.
features: Fermented black rice vinegar (black acetic acid) as the peel acid
Niacinamide for oil control and tone
Plant-acid basis positioned as gentler exfoliation
Targeted at acne-prone and congested skin
benefits: Adds an acne-focused peel option to the treatment menu
Plant-acid positioning appeals to patients wary of harsh peels
Supports course-based acne and clarity protocols
Differentiated 'black vinegar' story aids marketing
